layers.text: Recolour and change no shape: the pink frosting on the donut raft becomes glossy dark chocolate glaze #4a2412 with a lighter #7a4526 shine and tiny cream sprinkles; the pink and white candy cane becomes caramel gold #e0a040 and cream stripes. No pink is left. Keep the golden dough, the white whipped cream, the oar, every shape, the size, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
